title: How to Create Image to Video with Claude MCP and Medux
description: Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to generate a video from a source image and text prompt, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and results.
operation: Generate a video from a source image and text prompt.
prompt: Generate a 5 second 720P 16:9 video from uploaded image {file id} and this motion prompt using model id wan-2-6-image-to-video. This model requires Starter or higher.
